bullets: Added a local preview for embedded sites, enforcing 8-pixel alignment and a 2560x2160 size cap to manage display performance.
The agent now lists the available helpers only once at the start of a session, keeping the conversation history cleaner.
The assistant ends a turn immediately after responding to a report nudge, so the final summary is not obscured by extra notes.
Sign-ups using an email and password can now be blocked if the connection could not be verified due to privacy settings.
Sign-ups using an email and password can now be blocked if too many accounts were created on a single custom email domain that day.
The large right-side advertisement panel now displays at most one ad per campaign per day.
The narrow sidebar advertisement slot allows up to five ads per campaign per day and two per hour.
The cloud coding assistant explains specific resource limits when stopping, noting what hit the limit and if files are safe.
The DeepSeek V4.1 Flash and Fast models are now labeled with the 10/17 build date in the model picker.
Sponsored task prompts now describe the approval as an offer card rather than a consent dialog.
The error message for missing desktop applications now simply asks you to open the project in that app.
